moduleStoryDesc: A text with an optional image – factual, told by Georgi or as a quote.
moduleSlideshowDesc: Up to 10 pictures with text, browsed one by one.
moduleAudioDesc: A recording (MP3/M4A), e.g. an interview with a contemporary witness, with a transcript.
moduleTimelineDesc: Key years and events of the place on a timeline.
moduleBeforeAfterDesc: A historical picture side by side with today.
moduleArPanoramaDesc: Pictures and quiz float around you – turn your phone to find them.
moduleHotspotsDesc: Tappable points on a picture explain individual details.
moduleQuizDesc: Multiple-choice questions, optionally with an explanation.
moduleEstimateDesc: Estimate a number with a slider, then see the answer.
moduleOnsiteCodeDesc: The answer can only be found on site – such as a year above the door.
presetStoryTextDesc: Factual text, optionally with a picture
presetStoryGeorgiDesc: The dragon talks directly to visitors
presetStoryQuoteDesc: A saying with its source, e.g. from contemporary witnesses
presetBeforeAfter_sliderDesc: Drag a divider across two pictures
presetBeforeAfter_fadeDesc: Fade smoothly from then to now
presetBeforeAfter_cameraDesc: Old photo laid semi-transparently over the real place
presetArPanorama_cameraDesc: Pictures float in the real camera view
presetArPanorama_panoramaDesc: A panoramic photo as the background
presetOnsiteCode_numberDesc: e.g. a year on the facade
presetOnsiteCode_textDesc: e.g. an inscription or a name on a sign
templateTimeTravelDesc: Introduction, before/after comparison and a quiz question.
templateArLookAroundDesc: Georgi introduces, then pictures and quiz all around you.
templatePictureStoryDesc: A picture series with texts and a closing quiz question.
templateListeningDesc: An audio story and a timeline with the key years.
templateRiddleDesc: Georgi sets an on-site task, followed by an estimation question.
templateDiscoverDesc: A picture with info points and a true-or-false question.
moduleSequenceDesc: Tap events or steps into the right order.
presetSequenceChronologyDesc: Events, with the year revealed at the end
presetSequenceStepsDesc: e.g. how a clock was made
modulePhotoDesc: A framed souvenir photo on site – stays on the phone and can be shared.
